name: Pruvanserin
summary: Pruvanserin is a selective serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist which was under development by Eli Lilly and Company for the treatment of insomnia. It was in phase II clinical trials in 2008 but appears to have been discontinued as it is no longer in the company's development pipeline.

pharmacology.text: Pruvanserin acts as a selective serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist. In addition to its sleep-improving properties, pruvanserin has also been shown to have antidepressant, anxiolytic, and working memory-enhancing effects in animal studies.

uses.text: Pruvanserin (INN; USAN; developmental code names EMD-281,014, LY-2422347) is a selective serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist which was under development by Eli Lilly and Company for the treatment of insomnia. It was in phase II clinical trials in 2008 but appears to have been discontinued as it is no longer in the company's development pipeline.

fact.en: Pruvanserin shares the name ending anserin with ketanserin, the official stem used for drugs that block serotonin 5-HT2 receptors.
fact.zh: Pruvanserin 和酮色林有相同的字尾「anserin」，這是阻斷血清素 5-HT2 受體藥物的官方命名字根。
fact.zhHans: Pruvanserin 和酮色林有相同的后缀「anserin」，这是阻断血清素 5-HT2 受体药物的官方命名字根。
